column1: # Custom partition table for ESP32 2 MB flash with OTA support.
# Two equal OTA slots of 960 KB each.  The factory app slot is omitted so
# both slots are available for OTA.  After the initial USB flash
# updates can be delivered wirelessly via the OTA HTTP server.
#   0x00d000  otadata      8 KB   (bookkeeping for active OTA slot)
#   0x1f0000  (end — 64 KB unused at top of 2 MB)
